answer_1.quote: In this paper, we tackle the problem of automatic generation of football commentary... We then build and evaluate GPT-4o based models that take the corresponding tracking data as input and generate commentary.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation of the generated commentary by two of the authors... We assess three aspects-Accuracy, Relevance, and Ease of Understanding...
answer_4.guideline: Assess three aspects: Accuracy, Relevance, and Ease of Understanding on a 3-point scale. Accuracy: correctness of scene/match situation description. Relevance: relation to key play/salient moment. Ease of Understanding: clarity and evocativeness.
